label: Simulation on synthetic data
source: Offline evaluation notebook (agent_liquidity_forecaster.ipynb), not measured on real upay data.

policies.name: Agent habit
policies.rule: order when a balance < 30% of capacity, top up to 65%

policies.name: Hybrid (recommended)
policies.rule: habit buffer raised by the model's requirement at 95% coverage

policies.name: Model only (just-in-time)
policies.rule: order when below the model's recommended level

limitations: Synthetic data: the model recovers patterns that were planted, so results validate the pipeline, not real-world accuracy.
The model was trained on all of 2025, so replay dates are in-sample for the deployed model.
The risk engine assumes independent days, so tail risk is probably understated.
Recommendations only: humans decide, nothing is autonomous.
Needs governed upay data for validation before any pilot.
